content.text: In Zimbabwe, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-what-actually-how-2|Digital Product]] creators face a stark reality: global payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal are inaccessible. This isn’t a minor inconvenience—it’s a barrier to earning. But what if you could build your own commerce infrastructure? One that doesn’t rely on third-party platforms, doesn’t require subscriptions, and gives you full ownership of your data and payments? This guide walks you through [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/deploying-digital-store-cloudflare-pages-free-step-step-10|COREMERCH guide to deploying]] [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-supabase-order-database-digital-stores-works-how-5|supabase]] as your order database, integrated with Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments for automatic crypto payments. No workarounds. No dependencies. Just sovereign infrastructure you control. By the end, you’ll have a digital store that processes transactions directly on-chain, delivers products instantly, and scales without permission. This is how you build for a world where platforms fail but your infrastructure doesn’t.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is designed for creators who cannot rely on global payment platforms. It uses Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Supabase acts as your order database, storing every transaction securely and scalably. Unlike Google Sheets or Airtable, Supabase is a PostgreSQL database with real-time capabilities, meaning you can track orders, manage inventory, and sync data across your store in real time. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic without servers, while NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain and triggers product delivery automatically. This stack is pressure-tested in environments like Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and payment rejection are realities. It’s not a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure. You own it. You control it. And it works when everything else fails.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying, ensure you have a clear product catalog (ebooks, courses, templates) and a crypto wallet to receive payments. You’ll need a Cloudflare account (free) for hosting and backend logic, and a Supabase account (free tier available) for your database. Sign up for NOWPayments to integrate crypto payment processing—choose low-fee networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON for transactions under $0.10. Prepare your product files for delivery via Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. Finally, purchase the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for deployment within 48 hours. This stack includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration, end-to-end testing, and 30-day support. No technical expertise required—just follow the blueprint. This isn’t a DIY project; it’s a professional deployment of infrastructure that replaces platforms you can’t use.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by deploying Cloudflare Workers to handle backend logic. This includes order processing, payment verification, and file delivery. Integrate NOWPayments using webhooks to fire the moment a transaction confirms on-chain. Configure Supabase to store order details, customer data, and product inventory. Use Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive to host your digital products, with signed URLs for secure, instant delivery. Test the pipeline with testnet transactions before going live. The Edge Commerce Stack includes pre-configured templates for all these steps, ensuring seamless integration. You’re not building from scratch—you’re deploying proven infrastructure. Once configured, your store will automatically verify payments, update order status in Supabase, and deliver products without manual intervention. This is how you turn crypto into commerce, even when global platforms reject you.
Supabase replaces Google Sheets with scalable, real-time order storage.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your store on Cloudflare Pages and test the entire pipeline on mainnet. Send a real transaction using a low-fee cryptocurrency like BSC or TRON. Verify that NOWPayments confirms the payment, updates the order in Supabase, and delivers the product via signed URL. Monitor logs in Cloudflare Workers to ensure every step executes flawlessly. Once confirmed, promote your store to your audience. The Edge Commerce Stack includes 30-day support to address any issues post-deployment. Your first transaction isn’t just a sale—it’s proof that you’ve built infrastructure that works on your terms. No platform approval. No subscription fees. Just a store that processes payments directly, stores data securely, and delivers products instantly.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your store live, focus on scaling. Add more products to your Supabase database, expand your payment options with NOWPayments, and optimize delivery speeds with Cloudflare R2. Use Supabase’s real-time capabilities to build customer dashboards or analytics tools. The Edge Commerce Stack includes a scaling playbook to guide you. This isn’t temporary infrastructure—it’s a foundation for growth. As your customer base expands, your store scales without additional costs or platform restrictions. You’re not renting infrastructure; you’re owning it. And in a world where platforms fail, ownership is the only strategy that works.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

Supabase is a PostgreSQL database with real-time capabilities, making it ideal for storing order data, managing inventory, and syncing transactions across your digital store. Unlike Google Sheets or Airtable, Supabase scales with your business and integrates seamlessly with Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments. It’s free to start and grows with you, ensuring your store remains sovereign and platform-independent.
NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain, no buyer account required.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Ready to deploy this infrastructure? The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes everything you need: Cloudflare Pages hosting, Workers backend, Supabase database, NOWPayments integration, and 30-day support. Deploy in 48 hours and own your commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Prepare your product catalog and crypto wallet. 2. Sign up for Cloudflare, Supabase, and NOWPayments. 3. Purchase the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for deployment. 4. Configure Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. 5. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. 6. Set up Supabase as your order database. 7. Host product files on Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. 8. Test the pipeline with testnet transactions. 9. Deploy your store on Cloudflare Pages. 10. Promote your store and process your first transaction.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use Supabase on the free tier?
Yes, Supabase’s free tier is sufficient for most digital stores starting out. Upgrade as your transaction volume grows.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, BSC, Solana, and TRON. Choose low-fee networks for cost efficiency.
How secure is Cloudflare R2 for file delivery?
Cloudflare R2 uses signed URLs for secure, instant file delivery. Your products are protected from unauthorized access.
Do I need technical skills to deploy this stack?
The Edge Commerce Stack includes pre-configured templates and 30-day support. No technical expertise required—just follow the blueprint.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments operates on decentralized networks, ensuring uptime. Even if their service falters, your payments are verified on-chain, and your store remains operational.
Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic without servers, cutting costs to zero.
